note: Representative geographic reference points for the Immersive Globe prototype. These are approximate LOCATORS for orientation on a globe only. They are NOT the bounded study-area geometries, administrative boundaries, or route geometry used by the underlying research, and they carry no scientific meaning. FieldOS is a supporting instrument with no geographic location and is intentionally absent from this file. Coordinates are drawn from public gazetteer data (OpenStreetMap / Wikipedia) and rounded; treat them as indicative, not surveyed.
geometry_disclaimer: representative_point — not study geometry, not a boundary, not a route

reference_points.label: Madrid — Atocha–Puerta de Alcalá corridor

reference_points.source_note: Public gazetteer coordinates for central Madrid (OpenStreetMap / Wikipedia). Not the frozen two-route geometry in the HATI source.
